purpose: Deterministic idempotency/checkpoint identity contract for durable maintenance tasks. Static specification only.

rules.semantic_files_v1: Same semantic input bytes + execution contract => same logical work. Any relevant data/policy/code byte change => new logical work.
rules.trigger_run_v1: For live remote fetches, one orchestrator run is one logical check. A rerun of the same provider run resumes the same logical task; a new dispatch/schedule/push is a new logical check.
rules.parent_child_v1: A child unit is namespaced by the parent idempotency key and a stable unit type/id; it must never be reused under a different parent fingerprint.

notes: Do not use manifest dataset_revision alone: QA policy/exam-scheme/contract changes must produce a new logical run.
Unified Question QA is a child unit of this run rather than a second scheduler.
Effective-dated exam-scheme changes must invalidate the semantic run identity so a future approved profile is re-audited instead of inheriting stale checkpoints.
MOEX is a live fetch: do not suppress a deliberately new manual check merely because the previous fetched bytes were unchanged.
GitHub rerun keeps the same run identity and may resume; a newly dispatched workflow gets a new logical identity.
Stage 2/3/5/6 are runtime pipeline outputs and may not be committed on main; absence at integration time is a fail-closed condition, not permission to omit that component from the fingerprint.
Guardian routing is not automatically promoted to the scheduled ops registry by this contract.
This only standardizes identity/review-key semantics for later durable integration.
